name: markdown-preview-themes
description: Switch the built-in VS Code Markdown preview between fifteen distinctive dark reading themes.

enumDescriptions: Midnight neon with soft gradients and terminal-style code blocks.
Low-glare midnight editorial for long-form reading.
Monochrome CRT console with amber system accents.
Technical drawing board with precise drafting lines.
Dark modernist poster with primary-color geometry.
Black-tie editorial with brass, oxblood, and velvet depth.
Rain-soaked evergreen study with moss and firefly accents.
Restrained monochrome focus mode with crisp editorial rhythm.
Neon horizon, arcade glow, and retro-future grid energy.
Industrial charcoal workshop with copper and heat accents.
Deep-ocean calm with bioluminescent cyan and cobalt depth.
Plum library, rose ink, and warm mahogany reading room.
Midnight stone, stained glass, and jewel-toned geometry.
Polar night with soft northern-light ribbons and ice accents.
Sumi-black study with vermilion seals and quiet paper grain.
markdownPreviewThemes.selectedTheme.description: The stylesheet applied to the built-in Markdown preview. Use the Select Theme command for a visual description of each option.
